title: In startTetheredHotspotRequest of WifiServiceImpl.java, there is a possible permission bypass due to… (CVE-2026-58884)
description: CVE-2026-58884 is a vulnerability in the startTetheredHotspotRequest function of WifiServiceImpl.java that allows a possible permission bypass due to a confused deputy issue. This flaw can lead to local privilege escalation without requiring additional execution privileges or user interaction.
